description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 9 of 2003 Order No. 83
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a regulatory framework by setting maximum retail prices for rice, which constitutes a regulatory order with compliance requirements. While it includes a named individual (Maj. Gen. Shantha Dissanayake) in a signing capacity, this is not a government personnel appointment but rather the issuance of a regulatory order under statutory authority. The content primarily focuses on establishing legal requirements for businesses rather than government structure or personnel matters.
